zh.title: 美國空軍封存3架A-29超級大嘴鳥戰機 委由SNC維護存放
zh.summary: 美國空軍封存3架A-29戰機；委發SNC管理封存；不再執行飛行任務
body: 美國空軍發布公告，規劃將單一來源合約頒發給 Sierra Nevada Corporation（SNC），為已進入封存狀態的 3 架 A-29 超級大嘴鳥（Super Tucano）輕型攻擊機提供支援。這些封存於愛德華茲空軍基地的全密封型戰機，預計將不再代表美國空軍執行飛行任務。
根據合約內容，SNC 將負責機隊在基地內的安全存放、環境合規以及地面移動管理。美國空軍曾於 2024 年將這批 A-29 移交至空軍測試飛行員學校，用於飛行測試培訓、自旋測試以及感測器與武器研究，如今則正式劃下句點。

en.title: US Air Force Stores Remaining A-29 Super Tucano Fleet at Edwards AFB
en.summary: US Air Force stores three A-29 Super Tucanos; contracts SNC for base maintenance and storage support.
body: The US Air Force has issued a notice to award a sole-source contract to Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC) to provide support for three A-29 Super Tucano aircraft currently placed in storage. The three fully sealed aircraft are held at Edwards Air Force Base and are not expected to return to flight operations for the service.

Under the agreement, SNC will oversee the safe storage, environmental compliance, and ground movement of the aircraft within the installation. The move marks the end of the type's service after the Air Force previously transferred the aircraft in 2024 to the Air Force Test Pilot School for flight-test training, spin testing, and sensors and weapons research.
